services.title: Auto repair
services.body: Vehicles are diagnosed and repaired at the actual fault before anything gets replaced.

reviews.author: Gypsy Culbertson
reviews.text: Abbeville Tire and Auto takes great care of my vehicles! They always make sure I know what other items may need fixing in the near future giving me very fair estimates. They aren’t pushy, but definitely show they want to take the best care of my vehicle as is possible.

reviews.author: Carol Wheeler
reviews.text: Abbeville Tire and Auto is the only place I take my car for service. Their diagnosis has been correct each time I need service or repair. The repairs are done right the first time. I feel confident that they are honest in every aspect of the service. I recommend them to everyone

reviews.author: Bethany Gonsalez
reviews.text: I've been coming here for my automotive needs for about 5 years, the customer service is great and John is very understanding and helpful and willing to help you.

reviews.author: Lisa Parker
reviews.text: Went in for the first time for an oil change and was given a great job and very informative car look over. They checked the fluids, lights everything and gave me a list of possible things that maybe need attention at my convenience. Super clean waiting room great caring staff.

reviews.author: C Young
reviews.text: This place is awesome! I walked in and John greeted me with a big hello and smile. I got an oil change..tire rotation and 2 new tires within 30 minutes at a great price! This is my new go to place. Thank you for your first class service.

reviews.author: Mike Simpson
reviews.text: Very clean, relaxed, and pleasant working environment. Bryan was very helpful in correcting a problem that occurred and I never felt like I was being rushed. The associates made sure I was pleased with their performance and informed me of other services that was offered for my automotive needs other than just tires. Luckily, my problem was resolved in a hour. It is a privilege knowing that I have an honest and caring establishment near me when I need their services.. Thanks guys for a great job.

reviews.author: Roland Kneiding
reviews.text: I needed an oil change and they did a good job on my car and their prices were lower than most places I've gotten oil changes at.

reviews.author: Amy England
reviews.text: Totally rocked it! John had my tires the day after I called. Installation, etc., took less than an hour. All this for $500 less than what the dealership wanted to charge me. Highly recommend this local business.

reviews.author: Hannah Dillard
reviews.text: Very good service, staff is very friendly and helpful. Came in for a walk-in alignment and was helped immediately and my car was finished in a timely manner. Very reasonable prices ! Thank you for great service!

reviews.author: Charity Kirk
reviews.text: Brian, the store manager, was very helpful. I was visiting the area when my front wheel suddenly started squealing on a Saturday morning. Brian was able to have someone look at it Saturday before the shop closed and then do the repair first thing Monday morning. I really appreciated the level of service and attention to the customer.

reviews.author: Charles Beason
reviews.text: Awesome and very professional got us in and out with two vehicles. Are Armada needed a new tire due to hitting something in the road and they went ahead and checked my Mercedes to make sure we didn't have any damage to hit as I was following my wife and the Armada. Two thumbs up for this group

reviews.author: Susanne Hunter
reviews.text: Great local shop with competitive pricing and very courteous staff. I have had tire and repair work done and on both visits I was very pleased. They explain things in detail and don't push unnecessary work. They are also very quick.

reviews.author: Cristina Summers
reviews.text: I had to have the whole front end of my car replaced. They were so helpful an nice. They got me in an out at reasonable time an piece. Thank you so much for your great work.

reviews.author: Cookie Bonnett
reviews.text: We have had beyond five star service here. Brian is very professional and polite. I witnessed a customer yelling at him because his car was stolen from there, and Brian didn't raise his voice once. You could tell the man was trying to get him to go off. My advice to the man, things happen and it is beyond others control. Good job Brian, we thank you again for your service Bob & Melissa Ivey

reviews.author: Brian Smith
reviews.text: Very personable and courteous staff, had my car ready to go the next day. My friend from work recommended this shop and told me they were honest. Would use again.

reviews.author: FOTO_ FIEND
reviews.text: Best Prices around and save us a lot of money. Very courteous and super fast service too. Will definitely be back.

reviews.author: Herb Bonam
reviews.text: Our RV developed brake issues far from home. We must've called a dozen brake places, but no one would touch our motorhome. Until Abbeville Tire. "Sure. You can bring it in first thing in the morning. We open at 8." They correctly diagnosed the problem, ordered the correct parts, and fixed it. Bryan was professional, proficient and polite. Excellent service all around. We're back on the road again!!

reviews.author: Robert Murphy
reviews.text: I went there to get a flat fixed and talked to the service manager. He told me the puncture was too close to the edge of the tread (that was debatable, to say the least) and could not be repaired. I did explain that this was kind if a roadside emergency. Since he wouldn't fix the tire, I accepted his answer politely and then asked a follow up question. The service manager ignored my follow-up question and turned his attention elsewhere. It was, in a word, rude. I live in Abbeville and am now buying a full set of tires with my income tax refund. But I will take my business elsewhere. If you dont treat people well, you will lose thier business.

reviews.author: ANTHONY arrante
reviews.text: Great experience. Front man was friendly and professional. Only a minor repair but was out the door in 15 min . Would recommend to anyone .

reviews.author: Donna S.
reviews.text: Very accommodating and friendly, I would definitely use their service again. I recommend this place to everyone.

reviews.author: jason cape
reviews.text: Very professional group of guys! Even when they are busy they try to take care of everyone's needs. They definitely do there part to keep this town on the road.

reviews.author: Colby DeVane
reviews.text: CLEAN environment, public WiFi, phone chargers ready to use, up front and straight forward, no haggle and no worries. Fast and quality service.

reviews.author: Nakeno Amiri
reviews.text: Offers a consistently great level of service at fair prices. Definitely a customer-first shop and my first choice for any automotive issues or routine service.

reviews.author: Glenn Yandle
reviews.text: Even thought I had to show up before they even opened I was met with a smile and given impeccable service. I can’t thank the technicians enough for helping me with my flat this morning.

reviews.author: joseph knapp
reviews.text: So I drove my vehicle to this place then they tell me both my CV axles were locked down. And wanted $400 to replace. I asked them how would I have drove it if it was locked down. They couldn't give me an answer

reviews.author: Cortney Marshall
reviews.text: They work really fast and have nice people there to fix whatever you want. I been going by there for years

reviews.author: Rebecca Carey
reviews.text: Guy at front desk is ride not friendly..or maybe hes like that with women ive there twice and hes always not friendly

reviews.author: Sweet Innocent
reviews.text: Don't bother with an appointment, they will take someone else car in ahead of yours anyway. Customer service isn't the priority.
